identity: public pretrained model, adapted diagnostic comparison; not same-fold retraining or clean outer validation
scope: all46 violin tracks in existing186-track manifest; no selection by outcome

public_weights.training: CustomViolin; independent exposure to current works not established

selection: No fitting or validation selection. Fixed author-designated checkpoints; no outer-score tuning.

timeline.voice_assignment: minimum nonoverlapping lanes, stable source-index ties; no clipping/deletion; explicit adaptation
timeline.tail: at least1s after last note and full target coverage; common duration across lanes
timeline.context: whole track per voice, no hidden-state reset or 10s truncation
timeline.mixing: same instrument per lane; sum complete float32 waveforms at unit gain, no per-lane normalization or posthoc scaling

randomness.rule: one seed per track/lane/stage; fixed order, no reseeding inside sequence or best-of sampling

audio.implementation: whole-track original helper; no chunks, clipping, silence gating, gain fit, or alignment search

RMS.length: retain exactly cached target length after verifying output coverage; save full waveform separately

reporting.metrics: Frozen supplement/common.py metrics, all domains/min-note lengths/log floors/time scales
reporting.coverage: all46 IDs accounted; failed outputs listed and not dropped silently; metric None denominators reported
reporting.paired_bootstrap: same5000 group resamples and seed20260911 as supplement/report.py, common defined tracks per metric
sensitivities: target-hash dedup using lexicographic track representative
annotation-native single-lane subset, fixed before scores
reporting.interpretation: descriptive cross-system diagnostic; different training data/tasks; no SOTA/clean generalization/efficiency claim; historical researcher selection persists
